    "lighter brown side": [0.5365688800811768, 0.1327185034751892],

    "darker brown side": [0.37593114376068115, 0.3110314905643463],

    "pink": 6,
    "red": 7,
    "purple": 8,
    "violet": 8,

    "magenta": 8,
}

    obs = primitives.call(name="observe_cliport_rgbd", include_raw=False, prompt="observe before step")
    g = primitives.call(name="get_cliport_task_language_goal")
    goal_text = g.output.get("language_goal", "")
    print("Step", step_idx, "goal:", goal_text)

        break
